capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: The Eclipse Sportback is the rebadged third-generation Nissan Leaf with "the same 75 kWh battery pack" (InsideEVs); the Nissan global press kit lists 75.1 kWh usable for the Leaf 75 kWh pack (the bare "75 kWh" may itself be usable, so no gross is recorded).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists an NMC cathode for the Nissan Leaf 75 kWh pack the Eclipse Sportback shares (InsideEVs).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists a 400 V architecture for the Leaf 75 kWh pack the Eclipse Sportback shares.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Leaf sibling: Nissan Canada 2026 kit has a manual battery heater on all grades (navigation trigger only on some); no Mitsubishi page mentions preconditioning, so the lowest common feature is assumed.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Leaf sibling on the same platform: Nissan Canada 2026 kit gives a 7.2 kW onboard charger; Mitsubishi states no AC kW (J1772 port, Level 1/2).
